author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I don't know how to write "hello world" in Rust

Yet, I am checking in millions lines of Rust code created by my AI coding agent. Even if I wanted to, I can't review the code, I don't know Rust.

But, I know how to play around with the end product and use it as a user. If I haven't seen a bug, then it is bug free to me. If something doesn't work as expected, I will just ask AI to fix it for me on the spot.

If your software is open source, you don't need to ship it bug free, your user's AI can do just in time debugging and fixing. Move the testing, debug and patching downstream to the users.

It is the Shift Right Movement. Instead of shift the schedule to the left, we shift QA to the right.
